subject: Observability signal matrix & POC onboarding OKRs
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Kira Thompson <kira@finwave.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@finwave.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Observability signal matrix & POC onboarding OKRs

Hi Kira / Samir —

Thanks for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposal for the POC success / observability scope so we can get alignment and staffing on both sides. Attaching a working signal matrix and a preliminary onboarding timeline (obs_signal_matrix.xlsx, poc_onboarding_timeline.pdf).

Call highlights / asks we agreed:
- Goal: validate that Redwood reduces inference unit cost by >=25% at your 500 concurrent-session workload while maintaining end-to-end P95 latency <600ms and <0.5% generation error.
- Observability is critical for your SREs — you asked for dashboards, trace-level sampling, and log export to your S3 for auditing.

Proposed POC success criteria (draft):
1) Functional: model responses match your baseline quality on 5 core prompt families (we'll use the eval set you shared).
2) Performance: E2E P95 latency <600ms, median <250ms at steady-state; token throughput as profiled.
3) Cost: per-token inference cost reduced >=25% vs current endpoint.
4) Reliability/ops: end-to-end traces with span-level KPIs, error-rate alerting (>=1% generation error triggers investigation), and log export to your S3 bucket.

Observability deliverables (what Redwood will provide during POC):
- A pre-built dashboard bundle: Overview (latency, throughput, cost), Model Health (lossy outputs, hallucination proxies), and Ops (GPU utilization, queue depth).
- Trace sampling config and span naming conventions to correlate client spans with Redwood runtime spans.
- Log export pipeline to FinWave S3 (JSON lines), retention policy metadata, and a rolling 7-day debug log view in Console.
- Alert runbook: suggested thresholds, responsible owners (SRE / Redwood CS), and escalation path.

Proposed timeline (high-level):
- Week 0 (next week): onboarding call, credentials for S3 + test dataset, import of eval prompts.
- Week 1: deployed POC environment, initial traffic replay, baseline metrics.
- Week 2: observability dashboards wired, trace sampling tuned, and first cost/latency comparison.
- Week 3: regression checks, evals against quality gates, and final readout.

Wanted: confirmation on three quick items so we can lock timelines:
A) S3 bucket name + IAM contact for access setup
B) Which five prompt families we should prioritize (or we’ll use the ones you flagged in the discovery doc)
C) Your preferred on-call for escalations during Week 2 testing (SRE or Platform Eng)

Ben and Connor, tagging you for ownership: Ben — can you confirm the dashboard list and whether we can deliver a CloudWatch/Datadog template? Connor — can you own the trace naming and sampling plan? Marissa — can you pick up the onboarding logistics and shared drive doc?

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite once Kira confirms the start date.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com

Attachments: obs_signal_matrix.xlsx, poc_onboarding_timeline.pdf
From: Kira Thompson <kira@finwave.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finwave.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Observability signal matrix & POC onboarding OKRs

Vanessa — thanks for the detailed recap and for sending the attachables. This looks good and aligns with our internal priorities. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Success criteria: the quality metric should be BLEU / ROUGE-variant + our human-rating for hallucination (we'll send the human rubric).
2) For logs we need both generated-text snapshots (for sampling) and request/response metadata to be exported (timestamp, request id, model variant, tokens in/out).
3) Security: can you confirm that exported logs are encrypted with customer-managed keys (CMK) before landing in S3? We will provide the KMS key ARN.

On the five prompt families — we'll confirm the final list today and attach it to the Drive link. For on-call: we'll have Priya from SRE as primary during Week 2 (cc'ed on this thread after I add her).

Two asks for Redwood:
- Please include an example Datadog dashboard JSON so we can pre-wire our dashboards.
- Can the trace sampling be set to 10% by default with 100% for error traces?

If those are doable, let's kick off next Tuesday (July 25).

Kira Thompson
Product Lead, FinWave
kira@finwave.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kira Thompson <kira@finwave.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability signal matrix & POC onboarding OKRs

Kira / Vanessa — quick notes on ownership and what we'll hand over:

- Dashboards: we can provide both Datadog dashboard JSON and a Console share link. High-level panels we'll include:
  * Overview: request rate, tokens/sec, median/P95 latency, 99th latency, generation error rate, throughput vs capacity
  * Cost: token cost/time window, per-request cost histogram, projected monthly cost at scale
  * Model Health: distribution of top-k confidence, hallucination score (proxy), prompt family pass rates
  * Infra: GPU utilization, queue depth, worker restart counts, memory pressure

- Tracing: Connor will seed a sampling policy: 10% default, 100% for traces with status != OK and for traces tied to error-rate windows. Spans will be named: rw.request, rw.decode, rw.kv.cache_hit, rw.kernel.dispatch. We'll include a mapping doc so your telemetry team can correlate upstream spans.

- Logs: we will push request/response metadata + small text snapshots (configurable max chars) as JSONL to your S3. KMS encryption with customer key is supported — Vanessa, we'll need the ARN and an IAM principal to grant PutObject.

Runbook / alerts we recommend shipping with the POC:
- Latency spike: P95 > 800ms for 5m — page SRE primary (Priya)
- Error-rate: generation error > 1% for 10m — page SRE + Redwood on-call
- Cost spike: projected per-token cost > 130% of baseline for 1 hour — auto-notify engineering leads

Connor and I can produce the Datadog JSON and the sampling policy by end of day tomorrow.

Ben Carter
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Observability signal matrix & POC onboarding OKRs

Thanks all — helpful. Kira: if Priya is primary on-call, please add her to the thread and share the S3/KMS details when you can.

Action list (finalized):
- FinWave (Kira / Samir): share prompt family list + S3 bucket + KMS ARN by EOD Tuesday (Jul 24 local) — OWNER: Kira
- Redwood (Vanessa): send calendar invite for kickoff Tuesday (Jul 25) and attach the final POC charter — OWNER: Vanessa
- Redwood (Ben): Datadog dashboard JSON + alert thresholds — ETA: Wed EOD
- Redwood (Connor): trace sampling policy + span map doc — ETA: Wed EOD
- Redwood (Marissa): shared Drive folder + runbook draft — ETA: Wed morning

If we can get the items by EOD Tuesday, we lock the kickoff and aim for the Week 1 baseline sweep by Friday. I'll open a HubSpot opportunity update with the POC timeline after this thread.

Vanessa Ortiz
